summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan (plans/03_s4-ordered-driver-completeness.md, 6 hours, fully sequential) that closes S4 decidability by finishing the COMPLETENESS half for the ordered keyed driver modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered, whose soundness is already proved sorry-free and axiom-free (modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered_sound, FrameCompleteness.lean:8234, empty #print axioms list). This plan SUPERSEDES plans/01's Phase 7, which targets the wrong driver (live-guard modalTableauS4) and must not be resumed. Phase shape follows report 03's recommendation, refined from four phases to five: report Phase 1 was split into two phases because its two objectives have genuinely different verification tiers and commit modes -- adding modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_none_saturated is a single-file additive green sub-step (local/per-substep), while relocating modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_newExps_eq_map from FrameCompleteness.lean:7869 into LoopChecking.lean is a two-file move whose intermediate state is unavoidably red in either edit order (interface/atomic-batch, file set declared in advance). Phases 3/4/5 map one-to-one onto report Phases 2/3/4. The ~370-line Hintikka port is deliberately alone in Phase 3. Phase 5 carries Verification Tier full because instDecidableS4Valid is a new global instance affecting typeclass resolution repository-wide. SOUNDNESS CONSTRAINT ENCODED THROUGHOUT: soundness is FALSE for the UNORDERED keyed driver (machine-checked countermodel, CslibTests/S4LoopGuardRegression.lean, documented FrameCompleteness.lean:4088-4104); every new declaration name must contain 'Ordered', and Phases 3 and 4 each carry an explicit grep check for unqualified unordered references. Plan validated: validate-artifact.sh --strict PASS, 0 warnings.
